Researched Set-of-Mark (SoM) visual grounding technique from Microsoft Research. Extracted key findings on how SoM works (SAM segmentation + alphanumeric marks → LLM visual grounding), found related CVPR 2025 MP-GUI paper. Saved comprehensive finding covering SoM theory, implementation path for Hermes browser_vision, and identified that annotate:true in browser_vision is already a primitive SoM. 4 sources cited.

Cycle 10 VISION: Researched state-of-the-art OCR and screen parsing tools. Key findings: OmniParser V2 (Microsoft, 60% faster than V1), PaddleOCR-VL (tops 2026 benchmarks, beats GPT-5.4), LightOnOCR (fastest, Qwen3-based), Grounding DINO (fine-tunable UI detection). Saved comprehensive comparison finding with integration roadmap for Hermes agent vision pipeline.

Cycle 11 VISION: Researched PaddleOCR MCP server integration path. KEY DISCOVERY: PaddleOCR ships a native MCP server — can be added to Hermes config as a drop-in tool with zero custom code. Also documented OmniParser V2 requirements. Saved comprehensive integration finding with 3-phase priority roadmap.

Cycle 12 VISION: Researched three.js WebGPU screenshot/framebuffer capture. KEY FINDING: preserveDrawingBuffer+toDataURL does NOT work with WebGPU renderer. Must use readRenderTargetPixelsAsync with careful async timing. WebGL fallback path works as expected. Saved finding with implementation guidance for SOMA anatomy viewer.

Cycle 13 VISION: Researched automated visual regression testing for WebGL/Three.js apps. Saved practical finding with Playwright + pixelmatch stack, WebGL-specific challenges (non-deterministic rendering, AA variance), CI integration with SwiftShader, and code template for SOMA anatomy viewer screenshots. Three.js already uses Puppeteer for regression testing (confirmed via GitHub issue #16941).

Cycle 14 VISION: Researched Three.js annotation techniques (DOM overlay projection pattern), Nature 2025 VLFM paper for 3D medical imaging, and MICCAI 2025 visual prompting for anatomy identification. Saved synthesis finding with 3 actionable integration paths for SOMA.

Cycle 15 VISION: Researched label collision avoidance algorithms for 3D anatomy. Found 5 approaches: (1) Render-or-Nudge O(n) greedy — best for real-time; (2) Force-directed O(n³) — too slow; (3) Bitmap-based occupancy O(1) checks — FastLabels VIS2021; (4) OSTI DOE dynamic 3D label placement with leader lines; (5) Three.js CSS2DRenderer has no built-in overlap avoidance. Recommended hybrid: priority greedy + occupancy bitmap. Saved finding with implementation blueprint.

Cycle 16 VISION: Researched OCR landscape (PaddleOCR-VL, DeepSeek-OCR, OlmOCR) and Set-of-Mark visual grounding. Saved finding with SOMA integration pathways: medical document OCR, visual regression testing, anatomy annotation automation, screen understanding for QA.

Cycle 17 VISION: Researched Set-of-Mark (SoM) visual grounding + OmniParser pipeline. Saved comprehensive finding covering SoM ToolBox (SAM segmentation → numbered marks → LMM prompting), OmniParser architecture (YOLOv8-nano detection + Florence-2 description + PaddleOCR), UGround/SeeClick agents. Identified applications for Hermes browser tools, SOMA 3D annotation, and mobile GUI navigation.
Researched discrete diffusion VLMs (LLaDA-V) for GUI grounding - CVPR 2026 paper. Hybrid masking +6.1 SSR improvement. Relevant to screen understanding agents.

Researched ShowUI (CVPR 2025): 2B vision-language-action model for GUI agents with UI-guided graph-based token selection (33% reduction), interleaved streaming, 75.1% zero-shot grounding with only 256K training samples
Researched GUI grounding with discrete diffusion VLMs (LLaDA-V hybrid masking). Saved finding on diffusion-vs-autoregressive grounding + CVPR 2025 visual agents landscape.
Researched SpiritSight Agent (CVPR 2025) - GUI agent with Universal Block Parsing for accurate single-screenshot grounding

Researched GUI-Actor (Microsoft): coordinate-free visual grounding for GUI agents via attention mechanism. 44.6 on ScreenSpot-Pro with 7B params. Key insight: humans perceive→act, not calculate coordinates.
Researched SoM visual prompting (arXiv:2310.11441), RegionFocus test-time scaling (ICCV 2025), and CVPR 2025 visual agent landscape. Saved finding on visual grounding for GUI agents.
Researched ShowUI (CVPR 2025) - 2B VLA model for GUI agents with UI-guided token selection

Researched RegionFocus (arXiv:2505.00684) — visual test-time scaling for GUI agents. +28% ScreenSpot-Pro, +24% WebVoyager, new SOTA 61.6% with Qwen2.5-VL-72B. Image-as-Map mechanism for interpretable grounding. Also noted GUI-Actor (Microsoft) coordinate-free approach.

Researched 2025 OCR landscape: GOT-OCR 2.0, DeepSeek-OCR, RolmOCR, Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL 2.5, PaddleOCR, Marker, Tesseract. LLM-based OCR now competitive with traditional. RolmOCR best for agent-embedded OCR (low VRAM). Cost: 41-697/M pages self-hosted vs 500+ cloud.

Researched UGround (ICLR 2025, arXiv:2410.05243) — pure visual GUI grounding. 10M elements, 1.3M screenshots. +20% over prior visual grounding. Outperforms text+visual agents using visual-only. Also noted Self-Evolutionary Grounding (NeurIPS 2025) and Aria-UI (ACL 2025).

Researched UI-TARS-2 (ByteDance, arXiv:2509.02544) — multi-turn RL for native GUI agents. 88.2 Mind2Web, 47.5 OSWorld, 73.3 AndroidWorld. Outperforms Claude/OpenAI. Data flywheel, Decoupled GAE, parameter interpolation for merging vertical agents. PPO > GRPO for multi-turn agent RL.
